limitations: All 80 extracted studies had at least one partial agent failure.
S8 failed for all 80 studies because grok-4.3 was not a valid CLI model id.
The run predates the health-status population axis, so disease trials were not separated from healthy-adult questions.
Token counts and API-equivalent cost were not retained; only aggregate call and latency measurements remain.
The scoring constants had not passed anchor calibration.
validity.note: Historical extraction artifact only. All 80 studies were partial failures, including 80 S8 failures from an invalid Grok model id, and the run predates the health-status population axis. Do not use its scores as product claims.

outcome.label: Digestive side effects
outcome.definition: GI adverse events CAUSED by the supplement.

outcome.label: Anxiety
outcome.definition: Anxiety symptom severity on a validated instrument.

outcome.label: Cold duration and severity (treatment)
outcome.definition: How long or how badly an infection runs once it has started. A TREATMENT outcome.

outcome.label: Catching colds (prevention)
outcome.definition: Whether an infection occurs. A PREVENTION outcome.

outcome.label: Digestive comfort
outcome.definition: Bowel habit and GI comfort as an EFFICACY outcome (e.g. constipation treatment).

outcome.label: Inflammation markers
outcome.definition: Circulating inflammatory markers.

outcome.label: Joint pain
outcome.definition: Joint pain severity or function.

outcome.label: Muscle cramps
outcome.definition: Frequency, severity or duration of cramping.

outcome.label: Perceived stress
outcome.definition: Self-reported stress load. Distinct from anxiety as a clinical construct.

outcome.label: Blood magnesium level
outcome.definition: Circulating or intracellular magnesium status.

outcome.label: Night-time waking
outcome.definition: Wakefulness after sleep onset; night-time awakenings.

outcome.label: Side effects (any)
outcome.definition: Any adverse event, withdrawal due to adverse events, or tolerability.

outcome.label: Attention and focus
outcome.definition: Sustained attention, vigilance, reaction time on attention tasks.

outcome.label: Blood pressure
outcome.definition: Systolic or diastolic blood pressure. Surrogate, not a cardiovascular event.

outcome.label: Overall thinking and cognition

outcome.label: Cortisol
outcome.definition: Cortisol in serum, saliva or hair.

outcome.label: Low mood
outcome.definition: Depressive symptom severity on a validated instrument.

outcome.label: Recovery after exercise
outcome.definition: Restoration of function after exercise.

outcome.label: Blood sugar control
outcome.definition: Glucose regulation markers.

outcome.label: Lean body mass

outcome.label: Memory
